name: Edrath
summary: Edrath is a voxel MMORPG set in a hand-built fantasy world. You play a Wayfarer, a traveller who can learn any skill. Nobody picks a class: you grow by doing. Fight with tab-target combat, then spend an evening fishing, cooking, mining or brewing potions, and level each skill on its own. Explore the forests of Greenwood, the river camps of Ashfen Crossing and the Foothill Caverns dungeon with friends. You can also tame a beast as a lifelong companion, or rent a house in a town. Each server is a permanent world, and you can hop between worlds whenever you’re out of combat.
